top_choice_rationale: Both substantive proposals reward the same mature, independently validated GLP-1 achievement, and Drucker and Holst are common to both. I put P002 first because a physiology-and-active-form citation rewards what was discovered (proglucagon processing, the incretin effect, and identification of GLP-1(7-36) as the insulinotropic form) and keeps the citation scope cleanly at discovery. Mojsov's priority against Habener is disputed and cannot be verified from the supplied material, which is the weakness of P002. P001 is a close second because Knudsen's acylation and albumin-binding design solved the half-life problem and is real mechanism, but it moves the citation toward development. Either is far better than no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; documented co-authorship with Linnarsson and Frisen involves no credited laureate in P001 or P002
